messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, Wi-Fi Calling being ON can sometimes interfere with MMS functionality, especially if your carrier doesn't support MMS over Wi-Fi. Since you're on 5G with excellent signal and your APN settings are now correct, turning off Wi-Fi Calling is a good next step.

Please do the following on your device:

**toggle_wifi_calling** - This will turn Wi-Fi Calling OFF.

After you've turned off Wi-Fi Calling, let me know, and then we'll run the MMS diagnostic check again to see if it's resolved.

I have turned off Wi-Fi Calling on my phone. The status bar still shows excellent 5G signal and mobile data is enabled.

Should I run the MMS diagnostic check again to see if I can send MMS now?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
